thread:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: release/2026.03.21 -> eu-west-1 (rolling), canary = 1 pod per AZ. kicking off post-deploy verifications now
jen: noted. synthetic + kv warmup scheduled at +60s, embed smoke at +90s. will watch p95s.
matt: holding aggressive traffic ramp until synthetic verifies. plan: 10% traffic for 10m, then 30% if stable.
sre-oncall: i'll monitor kvprobe, heartbeat, and queue depth. set alert on 503 spike >3 in 2m.
li: quick heads-up — last week's warmup had transient OOMs during prefill; recommend staggered prefill and keep initial batch small (:eyes:).
deploy-bot: Canary verification report: synth-probe eu-west-1 -> 45/50 OK (90%), p95=220ms, avg=60ms. kv-warmup: 18/20 keys primed.
jen: synth pass is borderline. queue depth trending +12% vs baseline. keep at 10% for now.
matt: agreed. reducing cutover rate to `0.1` in routing config, holding roll to 30%.
sre-oncall: running targeted prefix queries and embed-sample now. posting results in 5.
deploy-bot: embed-sample results: 98/100 responses, avg latency 340ms, no errors.
li: saw one model-variant fallback in logs (variant-b -> variant-a) during warmup, that's expected on cold KV miss. note for follow-up.
jen: decision at T+10m: if synth and kv stable, ramp to 30% else hold/rollback.
matt: adding contingency: if synth failure count >=3 within 5m -> immediate rollback to pinned variant.
sre-oncall: synth at T+7m: reports flapping (fail, pass, fail). holding ramp, raising severity to P2.
deploy-bot: Alert: synth-probe failure count = 3 in 6m -> initiating rollout hold and notifying owners.
matt: initiating rollback of model variant on eu-west-1 to previous pinned sha (release/2026.03.18-alpha). doing graceful drain of canary.
deploy-bot: Rollback started. will revert routing and re-run verifications.
sre-oncall: running post-rollback checks: p95 latency reverting to baseline, queue depth normalizing.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. post-rollback synth: 50/50 OK, kv-warmup 20/20, embed-sample 100/100.
jen: summary: rollback executed due to unstable synthetic probe during warmup; model pinned in eu-west-1 until root cause triage. scheduling a dedicated canary window tomorrow with staggered prefill. :memo:
li: please add this to release notes and link logs: `s3://ci-artifacts/rollouts/5498887777/logs` and create a follow-up ticket.
matt: created ticket #ENG-4125 for root cause + next canary plan. thanks all for quick ops. :thumbsup:
